Why this title: Three farms + chapter system + town rebuild + lake mystery keep a production sim on a guided narrative spine

Why this title: New Moon says title shipped in under a year by reusing Sunshine Island / Mobile Harvest pipelines, marketing lessons and shared code
What to learn: Invest in reusable packages, authoring tools and event/content architecture

Why this title: Addressables bundle first-session/week core locally while seasonal/rare assets are CDN-delivered

What NOT to copy: Do not add remote content complexity before live-ops need exists

Why this title: Timeline authors building idle/produce/collect states and cutscenes/events; artists can preview timing
What to learn: Create reusable state sequences for production buildings and story beats
What NOT to copy: Do not build bespoke animation/control logic per building

Why this title: Deepwoods, Vacation Vibes, Stars & Lights, Summer Breeze and Anniversary passes reuse a multi-week progression engine

Why this title: Claire's Picnic and Dino Drama source progress from production/orders; Crab Control uses collect→deliver→event currency

Why this title: Deepwoods theme was community-voted; milestone/weekly vouchers feed social channels back into the game
